text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Come on, Taishin. We agreed you
would say it first,
didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sh-shut up. I was just about to say it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sorry, I'm just so happyyy! I-I...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin! Hayahide! I LOVE you guuuys!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Not only were you born between
us...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You really are the "centerpiece" that
holds us all
together, Ticket.
